title: Ratchet & Clank: Going Commando arrives on PlayStation 2
summary: In 2003, Ratchet & Clank: Going Commando became a notable game release milestone in PlayStation 2 history.

blocks.text: In 2003, Ratchet & Clank: Going Commando became a notable game release milestone in PlayStation 2 history.
In the platform category, Ratchet & Clank: Going Commando broadened the PlayStation 2 library and reflects the range of experiences available during the console's long commercial life.
